## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the reason for it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` when changing selection, capture, permissions, or lifecycle behavior
- [ ] Updated documentation for changed behavior or limitations

## Capture changes

If this changes screenshot behavior, include browser/version, operating system, tested zoom levels, and how the resulting pixels were checked. Remove private page content from attached screenshots.
